title: Classic Moroccan Lamb Tagine
description: A traditional North African stew made with tender lamb, aromatic spices, and dried fruits. Perfect for a warm and cozy Sunday evening.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay pot or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the cumin, cinnamon, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add the dried apricots and prunes, stirring to combine.
Add the chicken broth and water, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
